threads.label: Supreme Court Ruling on TPS
threads.summary: The Supreme Court ruled to allow the Trump administration to terminate TPS for Haitians and Syrians, limiting judicial review. Advocates are urging Congress to pass a legalization bill for affected individuals. The implications for TPS holders remain uncertain.

threads.label: Russia-Ukraine Conflict
threads.summary: Russia has intensified its attacks on Ukraine, launching missile and drone strikes targeting energy infrastructure. The situation remains dire with significant casualties reported. The conflict continues to escalate.
